about: The secreta of the formulary “First Passion Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord, may these gifts both loose the bonds of our perversity and obtain for us the gifts of Thy mercy. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: bring a woman to man as wife, match
